title: Oven Dried English V Sterbottensost Cheese Ploughmans Lunch
description: A citrusy and tender show-off British dish featuring V Sterbottensost cheese, this ploughmans lunch is perfect for a light and satisfying meal. It is also diabetic-friendly and features a unique brine-dry method.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150 degrees Celsius.
Place the sliced V Sterbottensost cheese on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dry the cheese in the oven for 30 minutes, or until it reaches the desired level of dryness.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, sliced apple, and chopped walnuts.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and olive oil.
Drizzle the lemon juice and olive oil mixture over the mixed greens mixture and toss to combine.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
To assemble the ploughmans lunch, place a portion of the mixed greens mixture on a plate and top with a piece of the dried V Sterbottensost cheese.
